limitations: Purposive 10-page pilot, not parser accuracy or QA evaluation
Exact-unique alignment measures direct compatibility, not text correctness
BBox bounds do not validate text-to-region correctness
No word-level multi-span source alignment implemented

observed_failures.observation: Inserted table separates acetonitrile (7 mL) from TFE (0.7 mL) continuation; both exports need layout-aware interpretation.
Docling merges table reaction-condition footnote into a left-column narrative item.
Substrate structure/yield graphic is a picture, not table cells; native PyMuPDF also lacks full structure-yield pairs.
Docling changes Ni2P@Ni12P5 spacing and retains download-watermark text.
Full-host Vision OCR recovers text but changes row 5 to S, misses several row IDs and the LiOMe row residual-substrate value 2, and corrupts table-header footnote characters.

environment_control.inference: Native macOS Vision behavior depends on execution permissions here; zero-text run is not evidence that Docling cannot OCR.

timing_observation.note: One local run, excludes environment startup; Docling includes initialization on first page and exports/alignment, PyMuPDF measures get_text only. Not a speed benchmark.
